episodes.name: Somewhere Safe
episodes.overview: Determined to learn earthbending, Aang works to free Bumi from prison. Zuko chafes at Iroh's plan to stay hidden. Azula receives a new assignment.

episodes.name: A Fight, Once Begun
episodes.overview: At a high-stakes earthbending match, Aang discovers the teacher he's been seeking. Painful memories emerge after Zuko befriends a farming family.

episodes.name: City of Walls and Secrets
episodes.overview: Aang and his friends must trade powers for parties and politics as they navigate the two-faced court of the Earth King.

episodes.name: The Water Falls, the Stones Emerge
episodes.overview: Toph puts Aang's skills to the test. In the streets of Ba Sing Se, Sokka searches for a missing friend, while Katara lives a double life.

episodes.name: Ten Thousand Things
episodes.overview: To uncover a mythic library that could hold the key to defeating the Fire Nation, the team is forced to ally with an old enemy.

episodes.name: The Parable of the Two Dragons
episodes.overview: When one of their own is captured, the team concocts a risky plan to reach the Earth King. An illness changes Zuko's perspective — and Iroh's.

episodes.name: Something Broken
episodes.overview: Torn across the city as the Fire Nation closes in, the team must reunite to save Ba Sing Se — and Zuko must decide where his real loyalties lie.
